Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You kick away from the ledge and let the rope take you. Your boots arrive at the landing ahead of the rest of you.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
Agility
Target / range / shape
A secured rope or hanging fixture and a visible free supported landing within 4 squares.
Type
Skill / Movement / Control

Make an Agility roll and swing from the secured support.

Weak
Move up to 2 squares.
Standard
Move up to 3 squares; push one enemy adjacent to the landing 1 square away from you.
Strong
Move up to 4 squares; push that enemy 2 squares away from you and apply Prone.

End at a free supported landing within the rolled distance or remain hanging at a reachable hold.
